svg.font-family: Charter, 'Bitstream Charter', XCharter, 'Sitka Text', Cambria, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.aria-label: Three scatter plots comparing the control expression of every gene between pairs of contexts. Points cluster along the diagonal but with wide spread, and each pair has over a thousand genes differing more than tenfold.
svg.text: The same gene, measured in two contexts
each point is one of 18,533 genes; axes are log10 expression in the control cells
